scientific_choices.rationale: Author proposal section4.3 specifies mask skeleton, cubic centerline, EDT height, normal sampling8x32 and rotated fallback for branches. This extension is absent from original paper3.2-3.3; no paper-exact claim. Reuse repository Zhang-Suen thinning; remove redundant graph diagonals; fit transverse cubic over the dominant rotated-rectangle axis, sample uniform projected coordinate across full pixel support and extend endpoint EDT radii constantly. Fall back for disconnected, cyclic, short, folded, rank-deficient or outside-mask fits. Numeric safeguards predeclared; no TEST tuning.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Shape-aligned shared features; failure reasons retained per instance.

scientific_choices.rationale: Use audited full1255 Gap epoch1/.9/preserve chosen before TEST, unchanged predicted labels, care admission, boxes and genuine frozen PARSeq AR1. Freeze segmentation and OCR weights; verify all source hashes before adding new sources. Existing F64/native256 from original Text/Kernel decoder, not Gap-specific features.

Existing RGB512/native256 F64 is not proposal stride4 F. Both8x32 and16x64 use this same F; no higher-resolution second feature map yet. Fixed detached geometry; differentiable only in F, bilinear align_corners=false, zero padding. Deep grid is interface qualification, not a trained deep OCR head.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Reusable feature sampler without altering previously trained checkpoints.

All300/2204 primary and same298/2187 hash-disjoint secondary; historically exploredTEST, no tuning/selection.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Expose gains and regressions without claiming trained feature OCR or H2 validation.

scientific_choices.rationale: Actual GPU verified before execution, FP32, single-image segmentation and batched sequential PARSeq; unload segmentation first. CUDA grid_sample inference; explicit CPU bilinear backward with autograd transfers for deterministic training because CUDA backward is nondeterministic. No silent fallback, installation, mixed precision or new training.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Deterministic feature gradients at a transfer/CPU cost; no paper hardware or shared-backbone latency claim.
